evidence.reason: The switch-unit option check is still performed only after `_load_helper`, and invalid switch option combinations raise `Refused` instead of a parser/usage error. The same file already routes comparable argument checks (health interval validation) through `parser.error`, so invalid switch arguments can load the helper and produce the wrong machine-mode error classification. The checkout switch branch likewise validates required options after helper loading. This is a minor implementation inconsistency, not a new requirement.
